meta.title: Cathedral of the Sovereign (5F)
meta.author: Dice Chaos Maps · Dark Magipunk Edition

B3 NW Monster Lair Spore Glimmer

dmNotes.title: B3 · Primordial Sovereign Leyline Rift (-42ft)
dmNotes.body: Three full levels below the Cathedral! A raw obsidian tear in the earth powers the Sovereign's entire temple 100 ft overhead. The east wall collapsed straight into the natural underground caves.

dmNotes.title: B3 · Subterranean Crystal Lake & Smuggler Boat
dmNotes.body: Flooded limestone cavern fed by the underground aquifer. A moored rowboat lets explorers cross between the Abandoned Aether Mine (NE), Bioluminescent Fungal Grotto (SE), Hanging-Root Lair (NW), and Cathedral Breach (SW).

dmNotes.title: B3 · Hanging-Root Monster Lair
dmNotes.body: Roots from Kiezpark pierce the damp earthen ceiling above a bone-strewn hoard of lost coins & rusted gear. Egg sacs pulse in the dark alcoves.

dmNotes.title: B3 · Bioluminescent Fungal Grotto
dmNotes.body: A jagged rope sinkhole links straight up to the B2 Cult of the Pale Root Shrine, bathing the cavern in eerie turquoise and violet fungal light.

lights.name: B2 Velvet Engine Jazz Piano Glow
B2 Cult Pale Root Ritual Glow

dmNotes.title: B2 · Sovereign Inquisition Black-Site (-28ft)
dmNotes.body: Hidden 2nd sub-level below the Cathedral Crypts. Five iron-barred heretic cells, a shackled interrogation table, a patrolling Clockwork Inquisitor, and the Faraday Quarantine Vault hiding an iron descent shaft straight down to the 3rd-level-deep B3 Primordial Leyline Vault!

dmNotes.title: B2 · 'The Velvet Engine' Underground Speakeasy (-28ft)
dmNotes.body: Hidden 2nd-level smuggler jazz lounge beneath the Ice Cream Express & Merchant Wine Cellar! Serves illegal glowing green aether-absinthe, hosts high-stakes underground poker, features a baby grand piano, and hides a barred escape grate straight into the B2 Brick Sewer Canal.

dmNotes.title: B2 · Smuggler Sinkhole to B3 Caves
dmNotes.body: Tenement smugglers knocked through an earthen sinkhole and staked a knotted rope dropping 14 ft straight down into the B3 Abandoned Aether-Crystal Mine & Underground River!

dmNotes.title: B2 · Shrine of the Pale Root (-28ft)
dmNotes.body: Hidden 2nd-level subterranean cult sanctuary beneath the SE Boulevard rowhouses. Bone-white roots strangle an emerald ichor altar while glowing spores drift up from a jagged rock sinkhole dropping straight into the B3 Fungal Grotto Caves!

dmNotes.title: B1 · Secret Wine-Rack Pivot to B2
dmNotes.body: Pulling the 1894 Sovereign Reserve bottle rotates the masonry slab, revealing a narrow stone staircase down to the B2 Inquisition Black-Site (DC 15 Investigation).

dmNotes.title: B1 · Cathedral Crypts & Coal Vault
dmNotes.body: Underground catacombs below the Grand Nave. Behind the High Saint's sarcophagus lies a concealed rug trapdoor dropping directly into the B2 Heretic Gaol.

dmNotes.title: B1 · Grandma's Speakeasy Hatch
dmNotes.body: Hidden under a burlap mat in the curved icehouse nose, an iron-ringed hatch drops straight down into B2 'The Velvet Engine' underground bootleg speakeasy!

dmNotes.title: B1 · Unit 4A Smuggler Trapdoor
dmNotes.body: Inside the padlocked SW cellar cage of 42 Eisenbahnstraße, a frayed carpet hides a steel-hinged hatch descending directly to the B2 Counterfeit & Smuggler Cache!

dmNotes.title: B1 · Watchtower Pump-House Shaft (B3 ↔ 1F)
dmNotes.body: Spinning brass gears drive the district's water mains directly beneath Wachturm Ost. The east-rim iron ladder climbs UP through a padlocked floor hatch into the 1F Watchtower Guardroom — and descends DOWN to the B2 Brick Sewer Cistern and B3 Underground Crystal Lake!

dmNotes.title: B1 · Bricked-Up Cult Archway to B2
dmNotes.body: Fresh mortar hides a pivoting brick slab in the SW corner of the tailor's dye cellar, opening onto wet stone stairs descending to the B2 Cult of the Pale Root Shrine!

lights.name: Vigil Stairs SE Wing & Threshold Glow

dmNotes.title: 1F · High Altar of the Sovereign
dmNotes.body: Black obsidian altar channeling violet aether directly from the 3F Dynamo. Two Clockwork Inquisitors guard the entry doors; tithe strongbox sits in the East Aether-Lift tower.

dmNotes.title: 1F · Wired Confessionals
dmNotes.body: Hidden brass acoustic tubes inside the confession booths pipe whispered secrets up to the 4F Inquisition Scrying Chamber (DC 15 Investigation).

dmNotes.title: 1F · Steam & Scoop Express
dmNotes.body: Locomotive-themed dark-magipunk ice cream parlor. A miniature brass steam train runs continuously around the shop's perimeter rails delivering sundaes & milkshakes; private back stairs on the brick Tender Patio lead up to the family's 2F flat.

dmNotes.title: 1F · 42 Eisenbahnstraße Apartments
dmNotes.body: Gritty 4-story Berlin magipunk tenement. 1F holds the cluttered mailroom lobby, overflowing rear trash alley, and 3 messy ground flats: 1A Sleepless Tram Conductor, 1B Packrat Hoarder, and 1C Card-Shark Baker.

dmNotes.title: 1F · Hinterhof-Kiezpark
dmNotes.body: Beloved working-class neighborhood pocket park tucked behind the corner block: homemade community tomato/pumpkin garden beds, mossy duck pond, squeaky wooden swing set & sandbox, pastel chalk hopscotch, retirees' concrete chess table, plaid picnic blanket & cast-iron hand-pump.

dmNotes.title: 1F · Stairs of the Remembered
dmNotes.body: For decades, citizens have left vigil candles, memorial glass jars, dried roses, and pebble-weighted notes across the Cathedral's forked stone stairs for lost loved ones. Thick yellowed wax crusts coat every parapet and the central U-niche shrine, still warm and freshly tended every dusk.

dmNotes.title: 1F · SE Hinterhof Yards
dmNotes.body: Working-class rear courtyards linked by narrow cobblestone alleys: hanging laundry lines, corrugated-tin coal & firewood shed, soapy washtubs, kitchen vegetable patch, chained bicycles, and neighbors' backyard card table.

dmNotes.title: 1F · Eisenbahnstraße Streetcar #14 & Sewer Manholes
dmNotes.body: Decades-worn granite-sett girder rails carry Prussian-blue Streetcar #14 past Steam & Scoop Express and the Grand Crossroads. All municipal manholes sit clear of the steel rails in road utility shoulders — and the two embossed alley manholes in the North Service Alley (34.75, 12.05) and East Winding Alley (34.75, 21.75) drop straight down iron rungs into the B2 Flooded Brick Sewer Canal!

dmNotes.title: 1F · The Cardboard Crown Kid Theater
dmNotes.body: Tonight's dusk matinee: 'Sir Scoop vs. the Clockwork Dragon' (1 copper at the East Popcorn & Lemonade Booth — free mini-cone at Steam & Scoop Express with every playbill!). Behind the Stage Left curtain, a pried loose stageboard hides the kids' Clubhouse Treasure Box: glass marbles, chalk stubs, a crayon district map, and a shiny brass key they found dropped in the East Watchtower alley!

dmNotes.title: 1F · Wachturm Ost Gatehouse & Pump Hatch
dmNotes.body: Eastgate Aether-Watch Tower duty room & holding cell. Beneath the sergeant's padlocked iron hatch (DC 16 Thieves' Tools or key from the NE wall cabinet) an iron ladder drops straight into the B1 Municipal Pump-House, B2 Sewer Cistern, and B3 Crystal Lake!

dmNotes.title: 1F · Keller & Kron Vintner's & Wine Bar (3F)
dmNotes.body: Warm neighborhood wine shop & tasting bar right beside Steam & Scoop Express. The rear stone stair descends directly to the B1 Wine Cellar — which hides the secret trapdoor into B2 'The Velvet Engine' Speakeasy!

dmNotes.title: 1F · Dampf & Glanz Steam Press & Laundry (4F)
dmNotes.body: Aether-heated copper boilers in the B1 cellar power twin rotary steam garment presses on 1F and pipe free fragrant herbal steam straight upstairs to the 2F Volksbad Bathhouse!

dmNotes.title: 1F · Eulenblick Antiquarian Bookshop & Curios (3F)
dmNotes.body: Dusty leather folios, beveled-glass relic cases, and chiming celestial clocks fill this shop opposite the Cathedral. Rear stairs drop straight to the B1 Relic Cellar!

dmNotes.title: 1F · Seide & Sohle Bespoke Tailor & Cobbler (2F)
dmNotes.body: Vibrant neighborhood tailoring & bootmaking atelier displaying bespoke coats in the bay window. The rear stone stair descends to the B1 Dye Cellar — where fresh mortar hides a bricked-up doorway to the B2 Shrine of the Pale Root!

dmNotes.title: 2F · Aether-Driven Pipe Organ
dmNotes.body: When played, sub-audible aether resonances rattle the Nave below and impose Disadvantage on Concentration checks unless silenced at the East Tower bellows.

dmNotes.title: 2F · Edict Scriptorium & Refectory
dmNotes.body: Open-railed mezzanine overlooking the 1F Grand Nave (14 ft drop). Clerics transcribe Sovereign tax decrees on the NW wing and share hot stew on the SE wing.

dmNotes.title: 2F · Gelato-Maker Family Flat
dmNotes.body: Cozy upstairs home of the family who runs the Steam & Scoop Express: parents' master bedroom (NW), kids' curved boiler-nose bedroom with wooden toy train playmat (SW), warm family kitchen & dining room, washroom, and sunny open-railed balcony.

dmNotes.title: 2F · Tenement Units 2A–2D
dmNotes.body: 2A Chaotic Magipunk Tinkerer (tangled glowing aether wires & workbench), 2B Bohemian Painter & Violinist, 2C Exhausted Young Parents (drying rack, laundry pile & 2 sleeping cats), 2D Night-Shift Printer's newspaper-buried studio.

dmNotes.title: 2F · Garrison Armory & Flare Munitions
dmNotes.body: Locked steel armory cage housing percussion rifles, 2 Magipunk Aether-Carbines, and red/cyan signal flares. Igniting the SE gunpowder keg & oil barrel deals 4d6 fire damage across the tower interior!

dmNotes.title: 2F · Keller & Kron Counting Vault
dmNotes.body: The merchant's dual-entry cipher ledger inside the brass-dial safe records nightly payments from 'The Velvet Engine' speakeasy two floors straight down.

dmNotes.title: 2F · Volksbad Herbal Steam Bathhouse
dmNotes.body: Beloved neighborhood public bathhouse tiled in mint ceramic & cobalt mosaic. Locals trade city gossip over eucalyptus steam while a secret loose floor tile drains down into the 1F boiler flue.

dmNotes.title: 2F · Tailor's Locked Pale-Root Study
dmNotes.body: White lime-mortar dust coats a pair of leather boots beside a locked desk holding pressed bone-white roots and sketches of the B1 dye-cellar false brick wall below!

dmNotes.title: 3F · Cathedral Aether-Core Reactor
dmNotes.body: Drives the East Aether-Lift, 1F High Altar, 2F Pipe Organ, and 5F Crown Throne. Sabotaging the 4 pressure valves drops all cathedral arcane defenses and alerts the Clockwork Inquisitors.

dmNotes.title: 3F · Cleric Quarters & Infirmary
dmNotes.body: Lived-in acolyte dormitories & tea lounge (NW), steam bathhouse & vestment laundry (NE), and alchemical apothecary infirmary (SE) treating aether-burn casualties.

dmNotes.title: 3F · Tenement Units 3A–3D
dmNotes.body: 3A Bootleg Aether-Alchemist (bubbling alembic & oil-stained lab flat), 3B Conspiracy Journalist (maps & newspapers wall-to-wall), 3C Retired Opera Singer & her 3 sleeping cats, 3D Freshly Moved-In Courier still drowning in taped moving boxes.

dmNotes.title: 3F · Off-Duty Watchmen's Bunkhouse
dmNotes.body: Smells of damp wool greatcoats, chicory coffee, and rye bread. The SW Patrol Shift Roster reveals the exact 20-minute blind gap when guards rotate between the Cathedral stairs and the Hinterhof alleys.

dmNotes.title: 3F · Antiquarian's Orrery Telescope
dmNotes.body: Fixed permanently on the Cathedral's 5F Brass Astral Orrery across Souverän-Allee, the old horologist's notebook tracks anomalous violet leyline surges every third midnight.

dmNotes.title: 4F · Inquisition & Scrying Dome
dmNotes.body: The brass Scrying Console lets inquisitors watch every tram line and alleyway in the district—and eavesdrop on the 1F Confessionals below.

dmNotes.title: 4F · Sealed Edict Vault
dmNotes.body: Heavy steel bank-vault door (DC 20 Thieves' Tools or the Arch-Vicar's key from the SE Suite) protects the Sovereign's original blood-compact charters and relic coffers.

dmNotes.title: 4F · Top-Floor Units 4A–4D
dmNotes.body: 4A Smuggler's Fence (contraband chest, strongbox & bottles), 4B Burned-Out Arcane Student (glowing spellbook & book piles), 4C Clockwork Tailor Workshop (wires, quilts & drying rack), 4D Rooftop Lookout with brass telescope watching the Cathedral.

dmNotes.title: 4F · Watch Captain's Command & Aether-Telegraph
dmNotes.body: The illuminated Tactical Map pins track smuggling runs between the Ice Cream Express, Unit 4A of 42 Eisenbahnstraße, and the Cathedral Crypts. Intercepting the pneumatic dispatch tube reveals tomorrow night's Inquisition raid orders!

dmNotes.title: 4F · Dampf & Glanz Attic Drying Loft (+42ft)
dmNotes.body: Sloped timber garret where boarders sleep beside steam-warmed rainy-day laundry racks, overlooking both the Cathedral Spires and the sunny SE Hinterhof gardens.

dmNotes.title: 5F · Throne of the Sovereign (+56 ft)
dmNotes.body: Pinnacle of the Cathedral. The Sovereign's Obsidian Throne channels violet leyline lightning from the 3F Reactor while the Grand Astral Orrery tracks planar conjunctions.

dmNotes.title: 5F · Aether Bell Belfry
dmNotes.body: Tolling the rune-etched bronze bell unleashes a 60 ft thunder/psychic shockwave across the open-air Sky-Walk Terrace and alerts the city garrison.

dmNotes.title: 5F · Wachturm Ost Battlements & Aether Searchlight (+56 ft)
dmNotes.body: Open-air crenellated watchtower crown with 360° sightlines over the entire district. Swiveling the Magipunk Aether Searchlight illuminates a 120 ft cone (revealing stealthed intruders); pulling the North Bronze Alarm Bell rallies the district watch in 2 rounds!
